summary.text: Tandy Darby is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 76 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tandy Darby lives in Greenfield, Tennessee. He graduated from Greenfield High School in 1992 and earned a B.S. in agricultural business from the University of Tennessee at Martin in 1996, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a business.
He succeeded Andrew Holt in House District 76 and assumed office on November 3, 2020.

For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and as a member of the Calendar and Rules, Education Instruction, Transportation and Fiscal Review committees.
